en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rocky coastal landscape with a small harbor. Several wooden piers and bridges connect low, smooth granite islands. Small sailboats and larger masted vessels are moored along the quays. In the foreground are rocks, shoreline vegetation, and a swimmer or bather near a jetty. A flagpole with a flag stands on the central rock. The scene has printed caption text at the bottom left and a publisher's logo with number at the bottom right.
